faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. Billo has a full offline mode. You can create and edit documents without a connection. As soon as your network returns, everything syncs automatically.
faq.q2: What language can I dictate my invoices in?
faq.a2: You can dictate in French. Support for other local languages (Wolof, Bambara, Mooré…) is under development.
faq.a3: Your data is encrypted and hosted on secure servers in Europe. We never access the content of your invoices and you can delete your account at any time.
faq.q4: How does the Pro subscription work?
faq.a4: The Pro subscription is billed monthly — the amount shown on the Pricing page and at checkout is what applies. It includes unlimited documents, client management and priority support. You can cancel at any time with no fees.
faq.q5: Can I use Billo on my phone?
faq.a5: Yes! Billo is a Progressive Web App (PWA) optimized for mobile. Add it to your home screen for a native app experience, without going through a store.
faq.q6: Is there a free trial of the Pro plan?
faq.a6: The Free plan is available without time limit. To try Pro, contact our team — we offer a trial period on request.

free.desc: As soon as you create your Billo account, you receive 3 credits. No time-limited trial, no credit card required. Use your credits whenever you want, at your own pace.
free.detail: 3 credits let you generate 3 complete invoices — enough to test the voice assistant on real projects, see how Billo understands your voice, and get a professional PDF ready to send.
free.note: These credits are offered only once. Once used up, choose the pack that matches your volume.
free.footer: No credit card. No expiration date. No surprises.

starter.name: STARTER PACK
starter.subtitle: For low volumes
starter.descShort: You invoice occasionally — two or three clients a month, no more.
starter.desc: You invoice occasionally — two or three clients a month, no more. The Starter pack is made for you. 10 credits for $4, that's $0.40 per generated invoice.
starter.detail: Buy when you need it. Your credits never disappear — they wait for you until you need them. No automatic renewal, no subscription running in the background during quieter months.

populaire.name: POPULAR PACK
populaire.subtitle: For active freelancers
populaire.descShort: This is the pack chosen by the majority of freelancers who invoice regularly.
populaire.desc: This is the pack chosen by the majority of freelancers who invoice regularly. 30 credits for $9, that's $0.30 per invoice — the best value for standard monthly usage.
populaire.detail: If you average 8 to 12 invoices per month, this pack covers a full month and then some. And if you have a slow month, your remaining credits are still there the following month.
populaire.comparison: For comparison: generating these 30 invoices manually on Excel or Canva would take you 4 to 8 hours. With Billo, it's 30 minutes total.

pro.name: PRO PACK
pro.subtitle: For high volumes
pro.descShort: For consultants, agencies and independents who manage multiple clients and invoice at volume.
pro.desc: For consultants, agencies and independents who manage multiple clients simultaneously and generate a high volume of invoices each month. 100 credits bought, 110 received — 10 bonus credits to reward commitment.
pro.detail: At $0.22 per invoice, this is the lowest cost per credit available on Billo. For someone generating 30 to 40 invoices per month, this pack covers several months of intensive use in a single purchase.

noExpiry.title: Credits never expire.
noExpiry.desc: A credit bought today is still valid in 6 months or 2 years. No pressure to use them, no credits lost at the end of a period.

stackable.title: Credits stack up.
stackable.desc: You buy a Starter pack with 2 remaining credits from your previous pack — you end up with 12 credits. Simple.

regional.title: Price adapts to your region.
regional.desc: For users in sub-Saharan Africa, South Asia and other emerging markets, packs are displayed directly in local currency with a rate adjusted for purchasing power parity.

noSubscription.title: No hidden subscription.
noSubscription.desc: You buy a pack, use your credits, buy again when you want. No automatic debit, no surprises on your bank statement.
